items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: yes, I did see him a few times after I recorded

ctx.x: Aaron Thompson -- he was -- I don't think Mr. Thompson was too -- I mean was too celebrated, but he was a good trombonist, and I don't remember -- I don't remember having seen him for years and years and years. I don't remember having seen him for -- well, I don't remember -- yes, I did see him a few times after I recorded, but I don't remember after that.
He's here in New York, though. He was here in New York.
